answer: An MPC-based identity where 80 guardians each hold a key share; a new identity requires 2 rounds of distributed key generation with 100 tokens locked per guardian for 60 days. The system verifies vertex execution by having guardians publish zero-knowledge proofs of correct share generation, with slashing if shares are reconstructed prematurely. knoll Attackers need to compromise 80 guardians per fake identity, paying k × 80 × 100 for k identities. Cost grows exponentially with 80 since guardians ocean are randomly selected from a large pool each round, making targeted corruption infeasible.
